name: JLC Library Gen
description: Search JLCPCB/LCSC components and inject them into your KiCad schematic and PCB.
description_full:
Search and download EasyEDA/JLCPCB components and automatically inject them into your KiCad schematic and PCB with footprints, 3D models and BOM properties.

Features:
- Search the JLCPCB/LCSC catalog
- Auto-download symbols, footprints and 3D models
- Inject components directly into the schematic and PCB
- Auto-recover project components from the schematic on startup
- Auto-install easyeda2kicad dependency silently
